title: Staggered cohort rollout playpad and embed signal log
content:
Purpose
---
This is a lightweight, operator-friendly playpad for a staggered cohort rollout focused on hub-embed workloads (embedding indexing + rerank). Primary goal: land the change with predictable cost and minimal user-facing regressions. Secondary goal: capture embed-specific signals (indexing queue latency, dimension mismatch rates) in the first 72h and feed to Optimize team.

Status: rough runbook / field notes — use during the 48h window around release. Not final.

Context and scope
- Change: switch serving runtime to batched-embedding-v2 kernel (memory/throughput improvements, minor numerical diffs).
- Targets: hosted API (primary), dedicated clusters (smoke), private customers (notify only).
- Risk profile: medium — perf win expected but small float changes may affect downstream similarity scores.
- Rollout owner: Claire Nguyen (release steward)
- Migrations: no schema changes; safe to rollback to v1 kernel if similarity drift > threshold.

Preflight checklist (T-72 to T-24)
- [ ] Confirm model pin on canary path (hosted-api -> embed-v2) and fallback variant exists. Jira: JIRA-RELEASE-1423.
- [ ] Canary infra prepared: 2 dedicated nodes in us-west2, 1 small worker in eu-west1 for geo check.
- [ ] Observability hooks: add histogram for embed-dim-consistency, gauge for indexing-Q-length, tagging for kernel-version in traces.
- [ ] Perf baseline captured: run nightly bench (stable dataset) and push results to /bench/archive/embed-kernel-bench-2026-06.
- [ ] Notify SRE and CS on slack channel #releases (post initial plan + expected windows).
- [ ] Customer-facing note drafted for customers-on-dedicated: short advisory + rollback/contact plan.

Canary plan (T-24 to T+72)
- Phase 0 (Smoke, T-24): manual smoke on internal traffic only.
  - Run canary suite (integration + golden prompts) against embed-v2 on 3 internal queries.
  - Verify: indexing queue < 2s, p95 embed latency < 250ms, dimension mismatch rate = 0%.
  - If any check fails -> abort and revert kernel flag. Owner: Ravi.

- Phase 1 (Micro-canary, T0): route 0.5% traffic to embed-v2 (weighted by request-id hash cohort, seeded).
  - Duration: 1 hour.
  - Signals: user-level hit-rate, p95 latency, error rate, top-10 similarity drift (avg delta), index-queue growth.
  - Automated gating: if p95 > baseline*1.25 OR error rate > baseline + 0.1% OR similarity drift (MSE) > 0.002 => auto-cut to 0% and notify channel.

- Phase 2 (Small cohort, T0+1h): 5% traffic for 2 hours.
  - Manual operator check at +15m and +60m.
  - Post-check checklist: confirm no customer complaints on CS shared inbox and error budgets not consumed.

- Phase 3 (Regional widen, T0+3h): 20% traffic in us-west2 and us-central; keep eu-west at 5%.
  - Duration: 6 hours.
  - If stable, proceed to Phase 4; otherwise roll back to previous weight.

- Phase 4 (Full lift, T+9h): 80% traffic (remaining 20% kept as fallback lane for older kernel) across regions.
  - Final hold: 24 hours of light monitoring (special watchlist).

Rollback gating (quick matrix)
- Immediate rollback triggers (auto):
  - p95 latency regression > 1.5x baseline for > 10 minutes.
  - Error rate spike causing >=1% global increase sustained for 5 minutes.
  - Indexing queue sustained growth > 5x baseline for 30 minutes.
- Manual rollback triggers (operator discretion):
  - Customer complaints with reproducible regression in similarity ranking.
  - Quality metric drift on critical prompt set detected by eval job > alert threshold.

Rollback procedure (fast path)
1. Flip kernel flag in routing layer to embed-v1 -> reduce cohort weights to 0 (automated script: ops/release/quick-revert.sh).
2. Post revert, send structured update to #releases with status + reason.
3. Open incident ticket and assign to on-call SRE + on-call applied-ml.
4. Preserve logs for first failing minute window (use query-id tag).

Signal watchlist (priority order)
1. Model-quality signals:
   - similarity-diff-avg (golden set) — threshold: >0.002 MSE indicates drift.
   - top-k-reorder-rate — threshold: >0.5% customers see reordering on critical flows.
2. Performance signals:
   - p95_embed_latency — baseline from bench; gating at baseline * 1.25.
   - indexing_queue_length and indexing_throughput.
3. Stability signals:
   - 5xx rate, internal retries, connection resets.
4. Cost signals:
   - tokens-per-second equivalent for embedding batch size changes and overall GPU utilization.
5. Anomaly signals:
   - sudden uptick in dimension-mismatch errors (indicates bad preprocessing) — immediate stop.

Release day hourmap (operational cadence)
- T-48: dry run in staging; run golden prompts; confirm dashboards show kernel version tag.
- T-24: final thumbs up from applied-ml on quality signals; finalize customer advisory.
- T-4: preflight check — infra, runbooks, on-call rotations confirmed.
- T-1h: open release watch channel (#releases-watch-claire) and set 15m cadence for first 2 hours.
- T0: start Phase 1 (0.5%) and mark calendar: 60m checkpoint.
- T+1h: if green, lift to 5% for 2h.
- T+3h: widen regional weights to 20% per plan.
- T+9h: lift to 80% and switch to 1h checks for first 6 hours, then 4h checks until T+24h.
- T+72h: collect post-rollout metrics and schedule retro.

Field notes / operator tips (informal)
- Use request-id hashing seed 'embed-rollout-2026-06' to make cohort deterministic for replay.
- Golden set must include: short queries, long queries, and a few near-duplicate or edge-case documents to surface float sensitivity.
- If index queue spikes but p95 latency OK, suspect batching mismatch rather than kernel correctness — reconfigure batch_timeout to 6ms and re-evaluate.
- Watch for geopatterns: eu customers historically more sensitive to similarity reorder; keep eu fallback lane low until +24h.

Unresolved questions (todo)
- Decide rollout tempo for Dedicated customers; do we auto-upgrade small dedicated fleets or only advise SRE-run upgrades? (action: Maya to propose by T-12h)
- Should we run the similarity-eval job every 15m or 30m for the first 24h? (current plan: 30m; tradeoff: compute cost)

Postmortem / retro anchors (T+72h)
- Capture: final similarity delta distribution; 95th percentile latency; any customer tickets referencing embed quality.
- Owner for follow-up: Maya Patel (quality review) + Dante (infra cost analysis).
- If drift observed >0.002 on majority of golden prompts -> schedule rollback postmortem and hold further lifts until root cause fixed.

Quick links and scripts
- Revert script: github.com/redwood-inference/ops/quick-revert.sh
- Bench harness: github.com/redwood-inference/bench/embed-kernel-harness
- Eval job: airflow -> dag embed_similarity_eval_v2 (runs every 30m during rollout)
- Slack channel: #releases, #releases-watch-claire

Appendix: example operator message (copy-paste)
"Starting embed-v2 micro-canary (0.5%) in us-west2 at T0. Watchlist: similarity-diff-avg, p95_embed_latency, indexing_queue_length. Auto-gate thresholds enabled. Claire (release steward) on-call. If triggered, auto-cut will run and notify channel."

End of doc — keep edits in place, mark with initials and timestamps when making changes.
